data.name: Pearl Harbor City - from Waikiki
data.headline: Tour 88 • Pick Up Starting at 11:00am
data.description: Explore the history and significance of Pearl Harbor and downtown Honolulu on this enriching tour. Visit iconic sites such as the USS Arizona Memorial, Pearl Harbor Visitor Center, and key landmarks in downtown Honolulu, including the King Kamehameha Statue and Iolani Palace.
data.highlights:
- Visit the Pearl Harbor National Memorial
- Experience the USS Arizona Memorial
- Learn about Hawaiian history at downtown landmarks
- Enjoy an informative and memorable tour
data.itinerary:
- **Pick-up from Waikiki**: Start your journey from convenient pick-up points.
- **Pearl Harbor Visitor Center**: Explore exhibits and learn about the 1941 attack.
- **USS Arizona Memorial**: Pay respects at this solemn site.
- **Downtown Honolulu**: View landmarks like the King Kamehameha Statue, Iolani Palace, and more.
- **Return to Waikiki**: End the tour back at your pick-up point.
data.what_is_included:
- Pearl Harbor Visitor Center admission
- Boat ride to USS Arizona Memorial
- Downtown Honolulu tour
- Expert tour guide
data.what_is_not_included:
- Meals and beverages
- Gratuities
- Storage fees for prohibited items
data.what_to_bring:
- Comfortable shoes
- Government-issued ID
- Sunscreen and water

data.booking_notes:
##Stops and sites on Pearl Harbor City Tour include:##

o Historic Downtown Honolulu 
o World War II Valor in the Pacific National Monument
o USS *Arizona* Memorial

• Driver reserves right to adjust route for maximum visitor enjoyment and safety 
• Be ready for spur-of-the-moment stops, unexpected views and special sightseeing along the way!

**IMPORTANT NOTICE:**

• Bring government issued ID; security restrictions at Pearl Harbor will be enforced. CLEAR BAGS ONLY (no non see-through bags that could offer concealment.) Storage is available at Pearl Harbor for $8.00 per item.

• OUR TOURS DO NOT ALLOW GUESTS TO MEET DIRECTLY AT PEARL HARBOR.  GUESTS MUST MEET AT ONE OF THE PICK UP LOCATIONS OFFERED; YOU MAY NOT DRIVE OUT TO PEARL HARBOR ON YOUR OWN.

• Attire: Dress comfortably, but please remember that shirts and footwear are required on the USS Arizona Memorial; swimsuits not permitted.  

• Snacks and drinks are available and may be purchased independently at the Pearl Harbor Visitor Center gift shop.

**NOTE:** Due to unforeseen circumstances beyond our control, the Navy may suspend boat operations to the USS Arizona Memorial at any time or impose a capacity restriction on the boat; as a result, occasionally, you may be placed in the standby line. Please accept our apologies in advance.
data.check_in_details: - Arrive at your pick-up point 10 minutes before the scheduled time.
data.special_requirements: - Guests requiring wheelchairs or special assistance should notify at booking.
data.restrictions:
- Swimsuits, high heels, dresses, and skirts are not recommended.
- Bags must be checked for a fee of $8.00 at Pearl Harbor.
data.faqs:
- **Can I bring a bag to Pearl Harbor?** No, large bags are not allowed, but storage is available for $8.00.
- **Is the tour suitable for children?** Yes, the tour is family-friendly and educational.
- **Are meals included?** No, meals and beverages are not included in the tour price.
